nodes.label: .brain — documentation index
nodes.rationale: Agents and humans should enter through a small index instead of loading every Markdown file.

nodes.label: Layered architecture
nodes.rationale: Organize code into technical layers calling downward.

nodes.label: Hexagonal architecture (ports & adapters)
nodes.rationale: Domain in center; ports are interfaces; adapters at edges.

nodes.label: Clean architecture
nodes.rationale: Dependency rule: dependencies point inward toward entities/use cases.

nodes.label: Modular monolith
nodes.rationale: One deployable with hard module boundaries without network calls.

nodes.label: Microservices
nodes.rationale: Independently deployable services with separate data boundaries.
